LANDING.TITLE: The finance app,
LANDING.SUBTITLE: your way.
LANDING.DESCRIPTION: Your account to manage expenses, savings, and debts. No fees. No hassle. Total control.

LOGIN.TITLE: Login to your financial terminal
LOGIN.HERO_TEXT: Welcome to Finance Manager. The tool designed to track your expenses, optimize your capital, and avoid financial surprises. Your money, your rules.

REGISTER.TITLE: NEW ACCOUNT
REGISTER.HERO_TEXT: "The first step to financial freedom is deciding to control your destiny. Sign up today and start building the future you deserve."

ERRORS.PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY: ⛔ Password must have at least one Uppercase letter and one Number.

FORGOT_PASSWORD.TITLE: Forgot Password
FORGOT_PASSWORD.INSTRUCTIONS: Enter your email and we'll send you a recovery link.
FORGOT_PASSWORD.ERROR_GENERIC: Could not send email. Please try again.

TUTORIAL.WELCOME_DESC: We'll show you how to use the app in seconds. You can skip the tutorial at any time.
TUTORIAL.HEART_FINANZE: Here you'll see your monthly expenses and savings. It's the heart of your finances.
TUTORIAL.ADD_TRANSACTION_DESC: Here you record your income and expenses. Choose the right category for better analysis.
TUTORIAL.CURRENCY_DESC: Switch between USD and BRL anytime. You can also choose your preferred language.
TUTORIAL.FILTERS_DESC: Filter by month, year, or fortnight to see exactly what you need.
TUTORIAL.CHART_DESC: The chart shows how you distribute your expenses by category.
TUTORIAL.NAVIGATION_DESC: Manage your savings and debts from the top menu.

SAVINGS.WELCOME_DESC: Here you can create savings goals and track your progress.
SAVINGS.ADD_GOAL_DESC: Define how much you want to save and what for. You can add money anytime.
SAVINGS.MANAGE_DESC: See your progress and add more money to your savings goals.

DEBTS.WELCOME_DESC: Register your debts and track your payments.
DEBTS.ADD_DEBT_DESC: Enter the total amount, who you owe, and the due date.
DEBTS.MANAGE_DESC: See how much you owe and record payments to reduce the debt.

TUTORIAL.FINISH_DESC: You're now ready to take control of your finances.
